description: This dataset holds New York City's monthly drinking water quality results from its distribution system, published on NYC Open Data and listed in the federal data.gov catalogue. The data tables summarise the turbidity values, coliform, fluoride and chlorine found at sites in distribution each month. Three downloads are offered, JSON, XML and CSV, from the NYC Open Data views service, together with column descriptions; the catalogue entry was last checked on 22 September 2026 and the dataset last updated on 21 September 2026. Coverage: one city's distribution system, monthly summaries, not individual samples. Access: free; the licence is not stated on the page read, and the number of sampling sites and period covered are not given. Caveats: summary statistics only, so sample-level variability and site identities may be limited. It supports water quality and disinfectant residual analysis in distribution network simulations and relates to the federal SDWIS compliance records in the catalogue.
